essential use cases are a good way to capture user interface requirements for user interface development, they are a good way of driving object-oriented design, and they are a good source for a common vocabulary of responsibilities for user interface design and object-oriented design.

essential use cases can drive object-oriented development, that essential use cases are a common vocabulary for user interface and object design, and that essential use cases provide the basis for a new approach to user interface development that can be called object-oriented interaction design.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of essential use cases in object-oriented development, and the benefits this yields.
the use of use cases in software engineering
how use cases can support the development of object-oriented systems, and in particular, how they can support the development and maintenance of the user interfaces for such systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the essential use case is a powerful and effective tool for object-oriented development.
the essential use case approach is a powerful and effective tool that can be used to develop a user interface design and an object-oriented implementation in parallel.
essential use cases are the most powerful tool available for object-oriented analysis and design, and they should be used as the primary tool for object-oriented development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
essential use cases provide a powerful and effective means for capturing requirements and driving object-oriented design.
the essential use cases provide a common vocabulary for both user interface design and object-oriented design.
the essential use case is the best way yet to capture and express requirements for user interface development, and the best way to drive object-oriented development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
essential use cases are not merely useful but essential for object-oriented design.
essential use cases provide a simple, lightweight, and effective approach to capturing requirements, driving design, and managing change.
essential use cases provide the basis for an agile, iterative development methodology that is well adapted to the development of interactive, user-centered systems.
